_comment: Billing facts for your seat pool. Quota is measured live by rota-engine.sh; THIS file holds the half that no API exposes: what each seat costs and when it renews. Copy it to $CFG_DIR/billing.json (default ~/.config/claude-failover/billing.json) and keep it in step with reality. A wrong renewal date here is worse than none, because it reads as measured.

_fields.accounts: Keyed by the seat's login email, exactly as `rota usage --json` reports it in the `email` field. Seats missing here still show in the table, flagged 'billing unknown'.
_fields.plan: Free text, the plan name as shown on the billing page (e.g. 'Max 5x', 'Max 20x').
_fields.renews_day: Day of month (1-31) the seat is charged. The next charge is that day in the next month the seat is still active.
_fields.amount_display: What was actually charged, including tax, in the currency billed. Shown verbatim in the table.
_fields.usd_approx: Number, USD, used only for the monthly total.
_fields.ends: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which a cancelled seat stops working. Only used for cancelled seats; a charge that would land on or after this date is dropped from the total.
_fields.source: Free text: where you read the numbers from and when, so the next person knows how stale they are.
_fields.not_in_the_pool: Optional. Seats you pay for but do NOT pool (a family member's Pro seat, say). Never read by rota; listed so nobody counts that receipt as a pool seat.

_how_to_re_measure: PREFERRED: the receipt emails. The ACCOUNT is the recipient address of the receipt. The receipt BODY never names the seat, it lists only the payer, so scraping bodies mis-attributes every row.
TRAP: a mail client's conversation date may be last-activity, not the message date. Use the message's own delivered time.
FALLBACK: the billing page. Sign in as the seat, Settings > Billing. Needed for any seat whose receipts do not reach a mailbox you read.
Renewal is a DAY OF MONTH, so the next charge is that day in the next month the seat is still active.
currency_note: amount_display is what was actually charged, including tax and in the currency billed. usd_approx is only for totalling.

team@example.com.source: billing page; cancelled, runs until the end date

family@example.com.note: Somebody else's own seat. Listed so nobody counts it as a pool seat or wonders what the 22nd receipt is.
